properties.description: Diagrams, mockups and rendered explanations produced during a session are captured into the content store and linked from the design node they explain — the visual half of a Decision's rationale, which is otherwise thrown away at session end. THE FILTER IS THE LINK, on Anthony's word 2026-07-31: a rendering is kept when a Decision or Capability actually points at it, so the store holds what someone will look at again rather than every intermediate. Capture must be TRIGGERED rather than remembered — a rule depending on the agent choosing to store its own diagram decays exactly as `req:skill-use-survives-a-long-session` measures — so this belongs with the trigger work rather than beside it. PLANNED.
properties.name: Keep what a session drew, when the design points at it
